Exercise: Machine Bicep Curl

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- elbow_flexion

Primary Muscles:

- biceps

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- machine

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- biceps_hypertrophy
- isolation_strength_training

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Elbow joint issues

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Barbell Bicep Curl, equipment: barbell
- exercise_name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Adjust the seat to the appropriate height and make your weight selection. Place your upper arms against the pads and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.
- Perform the movement by flexing the elbow, pulling your lower arm towards your upper arm.
- Pause at the top of the movement, and then slowly return the weight to the starting position.
- Avoid returning the weight all the way to the stops until the set is complete to keep tension on the muscles being worked.
